TAITO - MIDWAY - 1978

SPACE INVADERS

Insert a coin, then press 1 to start. For two players, insert two coins and press 2. Players take turns at the same controls.

C / 5 · Insert coin 1 / 2 · Start ← → / A D · Move SPACE · Fire P · Pause M · Sound V · Screen view F · Fullscreen

Destroy the invaders before they land. Press fire for each shot; only one laser can be in flight. Three bases; a bonus at 1,500 points.

Original game © Taito, 1978. Original program ROMs embedded.
Intel 8080, video, shift register and interrupt emulation. Original sound recordings: MAME samples / Dirt-Samples. Hardware reference: MAME.
